ci_support_linux_64_.yaml:
DOCKER_PLATFORM:
- linux/amd64
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
python_min:
- '3.11'

about.description:
checkmodel works out what kind of model you fitted (statsmodels OLS, WLS,
GLM, MixedLM; scikit-learn linear and logistic models; PyMC and bambi),
runs every assumption check that applies to it and draws a single
diagnostic panel. It also provides R², model_performance() and
compare_performance(). Every statistic is tested against R's performance
package to a tolerance of 1e-4. The optional Bayesian support needs pymc
and bambi, installed separately.
about.summary: One-call diagnostics for statistical models: a Python port of R's easystats/performance.

name: checkmodel
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.2.0"

package:
  name: checkmodel
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/c/checkmodel/checkmodel-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: c50122857f48c952c0a1b5cdf78c9f4fbb16ca4361558b6b53076adb3c1873ef

build:
  noarch: python
  number: 0
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - hatchling >=1.24
    - pip
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - numpy >=1.24
    - scipy >=1.10
    - pandas >=1.5
    - statsmodels >=0.14
    - scikit-learn >=1.2
    - matplotlib-base >=3.6

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - checkmodel
      python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}.*
        - "*"
      pip_check: true

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/pablo-legeren/checkmodel
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: "One-call diagnostics for statistical models: a Python port of R's easystats/performance."
  description: |
    checkmodel works out what kind of model you fitted (statsmodels OLS, WLS,
    GLM, MixedLM; scikit-learn linear and logistic models; PyMC and bambi),
    runs every assumption check that applies to it and draws a single
    diagnostic panel. It also provides R², model_performance() and
    compare_performance(). Every statistic is tested against R's performance
    package to a tolerance of 1e-4. The optional Bayesian support needs pymc
    and bambi, installed separately.
  repository: https://github.com/pablo-legeren/checkmodel
  documentation: https://pablo-legeren.github.io/checkmodel/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - pablo-legeren
